error.message: No profile satisfies this request. The task needs a guaranteed 128k context floor. local-code-standard and local-general are the only selectable profiles that guarantee any context floor at all, and both cap at 65536; every vendor profile's min_context is null, which cannot satisfy an explicit context requirement even though the harness behind it may well support more. Relax the context requirement, or supply a real vendor context measurement in the catalog - but not by retrying this request unchanged.
